items.q: Is the site visit really free?
items.a: Yes. We visit, measure and give you a written quote. You pay only if you decide to go ahead.

items.q: Do the cameras need the internet?
items.a: Cameras record to the recorder in your home even if the internet is down. You need the internet only to watch from your phone when you are away.

items.q: Can I add more devices later?
items.a: Yes. We plan every system so you can add cameras, lights or speakers later without starting again.

about.title: About Kestrel
about.intro: A small team of installers who like tidy cables and happy customers.
story: Kestrel started in 2016 when two network engineers began fitting cameras for friends and neighbours in New Cairo.
Today we plan and install CCTV, smart home, network and sound systems for homes and small businesses, and we still answer the phone ourselves.
